findings: The disposable clean guest reached Android-x86 and accumulated Android system state including SYSTEM_BOOT, system_server watchdog, low-memory, ANR and tombstone records.
The clean guest ADB endpoint remained offline after bounded reconnect attempts.
The token-gated viewer transport remained HTTP 200.
Live RFB negotiation succeeds, but the server currently emits zero framebuffer update rectangles. The old 1024x768 boot-logo PNG is historical evidence, not current live-screen evidence.

Disposable display A/B tests with std VGA + nomodeset, std VGA + xforcevesa, std VGA + xforcevesa + vga=791 + UVESA_MODE=1024x768, and vmware-svga did not produce a usable framebuffer artifact before the guest returned to console:/ #.
AWS resources were not changed by these tests.

interpretation.root_cause_boundary: Android-x86 graphical/display initialization and/or system_server stability under TCG, not token-gated transport reachability

next_gate: Capture a live non-empty framebuffer or authenticated ADB screencap from the same OCI code/node, then advance to workstation input acknowledgement.
